A Message For You

I'm Sorry, Dipali ❤️

Dear Dipali, I know you're upset with me, and I know that saying "sorry" doesn't automatically make everything okay. But I still need to say it... I'm truly sorry. I'm sorry for the things I did. I'm sorry for the things I said. I'm sorry for the moments when I didn't understand you. I'm sorry for the moments when I made you feel hurt, unheard, or unimportant. You never deserved to feel that way because of me. I don't want to make excuses. I don't want to prove that I was right. I don't want to win an argument. I just want you to know that I understand that your feelings matter. And if I could take back the moments that hurt you, I honestly would.
I'm SORRY, Dipali. ❤️
From Shivam

From Shivam's Heart ❤️

Dipali, Maybe I don't always know how to express everything I feel. Sometimes my words don't come out the way I mean them. Sometimes my actions don't show what is actually in my heart. But please don't mistake my mistakes for a lack of love. You are incredibly special to me. Your smile. Your voice. Your little expressions. Your presence. Even the small things you probably don't realize I notice. I care about all of it. And knowing that I became the reason you are hurt... that hurts me too. Not because I want you to feel sorry for me. But because I genuinely care about you.

Do You Know

What I Miss?

I miss your smile. I miss the way everything feels lighter when you're happy. I miss the little conversations. The random moments. The silly things. The memories. Most of all... I miss knowing that we're okay.

And I would do a lot just to see that beautiful smile again. ❤️

One Last Thing... ❤️
Dear Dipali, If you're reading this, I hope you know that every word on this page came from my heart. I'm sorry. I'm sorry for hurting you. I'm sorry for disappointing you. I'm sorry for the moments when I wasn't the person you needed me to be. I know a webpage can't fix everything. I know a few beautiful words can't erase a painful moment. And I'm not expecting them to. I just wanted to remind you that behind all my mistakes is someone who genuinely cares about you. Someone who doesn't want to lose you. Someone who wants to learn. Someone who wants to become better. Someone who loves you. I can't promise I'll never make another mistake. But I can promise that I'll keep trying to understand you better, listen better, communicate better, and love you better. So... I'm sorry, Dipali. From the bottom of my heart. If you're not ready to forgive me today, I'll understand. But whenever you're ready... I hope you'll look at me with that beautiful smile again. With all my love, Shivam ❤️

Some memories are pictures.
Some become a part of your heart.

You're one of mine, Dipali. ❤️

— Shivam
